I went to the vet's office on Friday, August 21st, as my beloved Chihuahua, Toy, was having trouble breathing and his tongue was blue. They gave him an injection and took an X-ray, telling me he was having difficulty breathing (what strikes me is that he didn't receive oxygen). Then you called a colleague for an appointment on Monday the 24th at 1 p.m. This colleague recommended a treatment to prevent pulmonary edema (administered at 8 p.m.). But when I got home, I couldn't leave my baby like that until Monday, so I took him to the emergency room immediately. The edema was already at an advanced stage, with blood present, because they told me it had been caught too late. They also said he had a heart problem that, strangely enough, had never been detected with a stethoscope during his vaccination appointments. He should have been on lifelong medication. Toy has left me forever.

At this point, I don't care about the money... because it won't bring him back.

But cashing a check for 113 euros?! When he could have benefited from some oxygen and a recommendation to go to the emergency room immediately without hesitation.
A big thank you for the support and care throughout Gamin's life, who has reached the wonderful age of 21.

I would like to address a very painful subject (the end of life of our beloved companions) to emphasize how, right up to this very difficult final stage, Dr. Zahra and her team demonstrated unparalleled empathy, gentleness, attentiveness, and professionalism, both towards the animal and its owner. This helped me immensely, both during the initial shock of loss and later during the grieving process. For this, I can never thank them enough and wholeheartedly recommend this exceptional team at every stage (key or otherwise) of our beloved pets' lives.
Excellent veterinarian. Compassionate patient, a truly wonderful person. I highly recommend Mr. Eric Zahra.

Extremely disappointed.
My dog ​​received a very poor diagnosis from the vet: "He's fine, just needs a shoe to walk on!" Yeah, right! I saw Mr. Julien Cabassu, an orthopedic specialist, and he found tiny pieces of glass in his paw pad.
Ten days of a large bandage, and if he's still limping, surgery. Never again, Mr. Zahra, that's for sure.
I absolutely do not recommend him, especially if your pet has something you feel isn't right.

A huge thank you to Dr. Zahra. He is always so kind to our little Stella. Despite all the challenges our little dog has faced, he has always managed to find the right treatment. We have complete confidence in him. The whole team is very kind. A veterinarian like him is a rare find these days. Thank you for your kindness.

I took my cats there for neutering.
We received a very warm welcome.
Both operations were performed on the same morning.
Everything went well!
Thank you.

Dr. Zahra was once again wonderful in caring for my cat; I think I can even say it's the second time he's saved her life! He also neutered my other cat a few months ago, and again, everything went perfectly.
He's professional and attentive; you can tell he does his job with passion and love for animals.
I also want to thank his team, who are fantastic and caring.
A very competent veterinarian in whom I place my full confidence, a very friendly and responsive team, I can only recommend them!
A veterinarian and his assistant who are attentive and professional. Thank you 🙏 …

A caring and available team.

A vet who takes good care of Leo, my diabetic cat ❤️, and doesn't try to inflate the bill.

I highly recommend them 😺
Highly Professional

The vet who had made a very good impression on me the first time I brought my rabbit in was very gentle, no fuss or nonsense. There was no assistant on the phone to block my call that day.

A year later, my rabbit has a gastrointestinal arrest. I call, and I get the assistant. The response: no appointments available for 48 hours. I explain that my rabbit has been in gastrointestinal arrest since Sunday, as all the vets are closed (it's Monday), and I preferred to wait for this clinic to open, since the few that are open have very poor records for rabbits. I emphasize that gastrointestinal arrest is a life-threatening emergency for a rabbit. She doesn't back down. I insist, reminding her that the clinic claims to be competent in treating exotic pets, and that my rabbit could die if it isn't treated as an emergency. The assistant, always fixated on her schedule, insisted on an appointment 48 hours later without even consulting the vet. As a result, my rabbit is now being treated by the vet at Pointe Rouge, who knows what a gastrointestinal arrest means = an emergency. He took the rabbit in, even though he was also fully booked. I feel sorry for Dr. Zahra, but faced with such an obtuse assistant, so unconcerned about the life-threatening situation, I won't be going back.

Thank you so much for your recommendation.

We're delighted that you were completely satisfied with your experience.

We look forward to welcoming you back again very soon!
Whether for routine care or during a difficult time, this is a fantastic team. The doctor and assistants are so compassionate and available... Without hesitation!

I highly recommend Dr. Éric Zhara's veterinary clinic in Marseille. I took my dog, Arya, there and was extremely satisfied with the care she received. The welcome is warm, and the team is professional, attentive, and very gentle with the animals.
Dr. Zhara takes the time to clearly explain the diagnosis and proposed treatment, which is very reassuring as an owner. You can feel a genuine passion for animals and a great commitment to follow-up care. Arya received excellent care, and I left feeling completely confident. Thank you to the entire team for your kindness and professionalism.

He was incredibly kind and gentle with our cat: we had to take him in on a Saturday morning after discovering an allergic reaction all over his body. Despite being fully booked, he agreed to see us as an emergency between appointments within the hour. He moved slowly, respectfully, and delicately so as not to frighten the cat; he even let me weigh him myself—in short, everything you look for when taking your pet to the vet. Thank you so much 🙏

Following a recent change of veterinarian,

I chose this clinic.

I found Dr. Zahra very gentle with my animals. He has already examined Joy, my little Tibetan Spaniel, Vivaldi, my Devon Rex, and Perseus, a Devon Rex seen as an emergency between appointments.

His assistant is very friendly, which is really pleasant.
We will be seeing my large four-legged family again soon.

Thank you.
The entire team thanks you for your recommendation. It's always a pleasure to welcome you and your little companions.

I brought my cat in to be neutered this morning.

It was a first for my cat, and I was very apprehensive, but everything went very well.
Thank you to Cornelia for her warm welcome, her explanations, and her reassuring manner. I'm very satisfied with the service.
Friendly welcome and good interaction with my dog.
Very good, warm welcome, quick service, friendly staff, I recommend it.
Mr. Zahra is very professional and has excellent diagnostic skills; I have complete confidence in him.

Best vet in Marseille, I recommend him to everyone. He's patient and attentive; you can tell he loves animals. My little cat is very happy when she goes to him. He's gentle with her and gives good advice.

And above all, he's not a salesman like some; he puts animal welfare first. His receptionist is also very kind. I recommend him without hesitation.
Dr. Zahra and her team warmly thank you for your recommendation.
The entire healthcare team thanks you for your support and recommendation.

I came in right when they opened, without an appointment, because my elderly dog ​​was very tired. I received a warm welcome, as always, and Dr. Zahra was, as usual, perfect. Thank you to the whole team!
Excellent service both in person and by phone; the veterinarian is very professional and offers good advice. I highly recommend him.
Very satisfied for the past 4 years, always giving me good advice for my cat Shanel
Dr. Zahra and her team thank you for your recommendation.

I mainly spoke with the veterinarian, Mr. Éric Zahra, who demonstrated great patience, calm, and politeness throughout the visit. The atmosphere was gentle and reassuring, even when my cat Mika started to get stressed. It was almost me who needed calming at that point—but everything was handled with great care and kindness.

I am truly grateful for this warm and professional welcome. A wonderful experience during a difficult time. Thank you again.

P.S. I will not hesitate to recommend the clinic to others and will return with my cat if needed.

My cat's spaying went perfectly; she was back to her old self very quickly, which wasn't the case for my other cat. He had a simpler procedure (he's a male), but it was still botched at another clinic, and they even charged more! 🤦🏽‍♀️ I was a little worried, but everything went very well and quickly, and the lady who greeted me and my little girl was very kind and smiling. 🥰 Here's a picture of my Fifi looking great that same evening.
The best
Dr. Zahra and her team thank you for your recommendation.
Dr. Zahra and her team thank you for your recommendation.
Dr. Zahra and her team thank you for your recommendation.

Honestly, I'm a little disappointed. I took my cat Milka in because he was scratching his ears excessively. The vet told me, "His ears are dirty." I also showed him a bald patch in his fur, and he said it was nothing serious and that he didn't know the cause. As the days went by, the bald patch got bigger, and I needed a second opinion from another vet. In the end, it was completely unrelated; my cat actually had a bacterial infection, which explained the scratching around his ears and the bald patch. Mistakes happen, I suppose. I just wish they had paid a little more attention to what was wrong with him. However, that doesn't detract from the kindness of the vet and his team.
Alright!

I have 2 cats who have been treated by other veterinarians. One of my cats is diabetic; the veterinarians who treated him seemed at a loss. I even heard one of them talk about euthanasia. Dr. Zahra seems competent; he listens and is gentle with animals. Given my cat's illness, there isn't much to be done; I will simply do my best with this veterinarian's advice.

Thank you very much.
Dr. Zahra and her team
I thank Dr. Zahra for her professionalism and also her very pleasant assistant. My cat Pitchou's neutering went very well. I will return if needed for my kitten's follow-up care. Highly recommended.

A very gentle, patient, and reassuring vet. He always takes such good care of Poppy; you can tell he loves animals, and it makes all the difference. Excellent advice and follow-up care—a vet you can trust!
The other staff at the practice are lovely too; thank you to them.

Avoid at all costs! This place is all about taking money, not healing!!!
We brought our cat in twice because his condition was deteriorating. He was barely eating, becoming incontinent, stopped grooming himself, and was pulling out large clumps of fur. After we explained the situation, he told us it was normal and that he was simply old, and didn't even bother to examine him, even after we insisted. A few days later, as his condition wasn't improving, we took him to the K Emergency Veterinary Clinic (which I highly recommend). Within minutes, they understood the situation, took his temperature, and saw that he was getting cold. We therefore had to euthanize our cat. Because of Mr. Zahra, our cat suffered needlessly when he could have passed away peacefully after a simple examination. A complete fraud! If you love your pet, don't go there!
Professional and caring team!
Thank you so much for the support of our little Fifi 🙏🏻 She was treated beautifully until the very end …

I consulted Dr. Zahra for a complicated problem with my 18-year-old cat.
I received excellent advice.
The doctor was available, highly competent, and honest.
A private practice I highly recommend.
Dr. Zahra and her team thank you very much for your recommendation.
Excellent welcome, superb diagnosis, highly effective treatment. Very satisfied.
Dr. Zahra and her team thank you for your trust.
